summary: FD_TC_165_No Determination | ASL | Disruption on OAL
title: No Determination | ASL | Disruption on OAL
description:
Israel-route multi-leg journey where the MSL (most significant leg with the disruption) is operated by a NON-Star Alliance OAL. AC does not have data-sharing agreements with non-Star carriers, so disruption codes and operating times are unavailable. DDS cannot determine eligibility because the disrupted leg's data is inaccessible. Customer is redirected to the OAL. Different from ND-02 (Star Alliance partner, where StarQuest process applies) � non-Star OALs have no AC data pathway at all.

Prerequisites:
PNR: Single passenger. Journey: Multi-leg, Israel origin. MSL: On OAL leg (non-Star Alliance carrier). AC leg: Completed on time. OAL leg: Disrupted � data NOT available to AC (no data-sharing agreement with non-Star carrier). Regime: ASL applicable (Israel route).
